            "text": "    Creates a publication-quality figure comparing the empirical covariance",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    (computed e.g. by :func:&#96;~stamps.stats.dependence.stcov.stcov&#96;)",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "    against a parametric covariance model.",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "    * **Pure spatial** (&#96;&#96;tLag=None&#96;&#96;) — a single 2-D line plot of",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "      &#96;&#96;C&#96;&#96; vs &#96;&#96;rLag&#96;&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "    * **Space-time** (&#96;&#96;tLag&#96;&#96; provided) — a three-panel layout: spatial",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "      profile (top-left), temporal profile (bottom-left), and a 3-D scatter /",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "      wireframe of the full space-time covariance surface (right).",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "    Parameters",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "    ----------",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "    C : np.ndarray, shape (ns, nt) or (ns,)",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "        Empirical covariance values.  For pure-spatial data the shape is",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "        &#96;&#96;(ns,)&#96;&#96; or &#96;&#96;(ns, 1)&#96;&#96;; for space-time data &#96;&#96;(ns, nt)&#96;&#96; where",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "        &#96;&#96;ns&#96;&#96; is the number of spatial lags and &#96;&#96;nt&#96;&#96; the number of temporal",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "        lags.",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "    rLag : np.ndarray, shape (ns,)",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "        Spatial lag values at which **C** was computed.",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "    tLag : np.ndarray, shape (nt,) or None, optional",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "        Temporal lag values.  Pass &#96;&#96;None&#96;&#96; (default) for a pure-spatial plot.",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "    covmodel : list of str or None, optional",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "        Nested covariance model name list in stamps format.  If &#96;&#96;None&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "        (default), only the empirical covariance is plotted.",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "    covparam : list of list or None, optional",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "        Nested covariance parameter list matching *covmodel*.  See",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "        :func:&#96;~stamps.general.coord2K.coord2K&#96; for format details.",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "    Returns",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "    -------",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "    list",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "        * If &#96;&#96;tLag&#96;&#96; is provided: &#96;&#96;[ax1, ax2, ax3]&#96;&#96; — three",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "          :class:&#96;matplotlib.axes.Axes&#96; objects (spatial profile, temporal",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "          profile, 3-D surface).",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "        * If &#96;&#96;tLag&#96;&#96; is &#96;&#96;None&#96;&#96;: &#96;&#96;[ax, line]&#96;&#96; where &#96;&#96;ax&#96;&#96; is a",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "          :class:&#96;matplotlib.axes.Axes&#96; and &#96;&#96;line&#96;&#96; is the plotted",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "          :class:&#96;matplotlib.lines.Line2D&#96; (or a list of two Line2D objects",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "          when a model is overlaid).",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "    Notes",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "    -----",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    The model overlay is evaluated on a fine grid of 50 points along each",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "    lag axis using :func:&#96;~stamps.stats.dependence.stcovfit.covmodelest&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "    For the 3-D panel the view angle is set to &#96;&#96;(30, -15)&#96;&#96; degrees.",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "    Examples",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "    --------",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; import numpy as np",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; from stamps.graph.modelplot import modelplot",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; rLag = np.arange(0, 100, 10)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; C = np.exp(-rLag / 30.0)         # synthetic spatial covariance",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; axs = modelplot(C, rLag)          # pure spatial, no model overlay",
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; # With model overlay:",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; covmodel = ['exponentialC']",
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; covparam = [[10.0, [30.0]]]",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; axs = modelplot(C, rLag, covmodel=covmodel, covparam=covparam)",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "    Space-time example (synthetic):",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; tLag = np.arange(0, 6)",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; C_st = np.outer(C, np.exp(-tLag / 2.0))  # shape (10, 6)",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; axs = modelplot(C_st, rLag, tLag=tLag)",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "    ### Original Reference ###",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "    Plot the empirical and modeled covariances for both spatial and S/T cases.",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "    Args:",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "        C (ndarray): shape (ns, nt). Empirical covariance.",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "        rLag (ndarray): shape (ns, 1). Spatial lags.",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "        tLag (ndarray): shape (nt, 1). Temporal lags.",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "        covmodel (list): default None — only plots empirical covariance.",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "        covparam (list): Parameter of Covariance model.",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "    Returns:",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "text": "        axs (list): list of matplotlib.axes objects or [ax, line] for spatial case.",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "    Remark: details of covmodel and covparam can refer to stamps.general.coord2K",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "    if tLag is not None: # space-time case",
            "lineNumber": 96
          },
          {
            "text": "        tLagM,rLagM=np.meshgrid(tLag,rLag)",
            "lineNumber": 97
          }
        ]

          },

        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": " ",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "def mlemodelplot(ch, zh, covmodel=None, covparam=None):",
            "lineNumber": 290,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"\"\"Scatter-plot raw cross-products vs distance and overlay a covariance model.",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "text": "    For each pair of observations the product &#96;&#96;z_i * z_j&#96;&#96; is plotted",
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "text": "    against the pairwise Euclidean distance.  If a covariance model is",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "    provided it is overlaid as a red line, giving a visual check of the",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "    MLE-fitted model against the raw data cloud.",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "text": "    Parameters",
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "    ----------",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "    ch : np.ndarray, shape (nh, nd)",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "        Observation coordinate matrix.  The last column may contain",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "        &#96;&#96;numpy.datetime64&#96;&#96; values, which are converted to &#96;&#96;float64&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "        relative to the first observation time.",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "    zh : np.ndarray, shape (nh,) or (nh, 1)",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "        Observed values; reshaped to &#96;&#96;(nh, 1)&#96;&#96; internally.",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "text": "    covmodel : list of str or None, optional",
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "        Nested covariance model name list in stamps format.  &#96;&#96;None&#96;&#96; plots",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "        only the data scatter.",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "    covparam : list of list or None, optional",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "        Corresponding covariance parameters.",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "    Returns",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "    -------",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "    None",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "        The function calls :func:&#96;matplotlib.pyplot.figure&#96; and",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "        :func:&#96;matplotlib.pyplot.show&#96; directly.",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "    Notes",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "    -----",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "    Only the upper triangle of the &#96;&#96;(nh × nh)&#96;&#96; cross-product matrix is",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "    plotted (using &#96;&#96;numpy.triu_indices&#96;&#96;) to avoid duplicating symmetric",
            "lineNumber": 321
          },
          {
            "text": "    pairs.",
            "lineNumber": 322
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 323
          },
          {
            "text": "    The model overlay is evaluated on 50 equally spaced lag values covering",
            "lineNumber": 324
          },
          {
            "text": "    &#96;&#96;[0, 2/3 × max_distance]&#96;&#96; for both spatial and temporal axes.",
            "lineNumber": 325
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 326
          },
          {
            "text": "    For space-time data (&#96;&#96;ch.shape[1] &gt; 2&#96;&#96;) the temporal distance is also",
            "lineNumber": 327
          },
          {
            "text": "    computed, but the current implementation prints an empty string and the",
            "lineNumber": 328
          },
          {
            "text": "    plot is not yet generated for this case (marked as *to be written*).",
            "lineNumber": 329
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 330
          },
          {
            "text": "    Examples",
            "lineNumber": 331
          },
          {
            "text": "    --------",
            "lineNumber": 332
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; import numpy as np",
            "lineNumber": 333
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; from stamps.graph.modelplot import mlemodelplot",
            "lineNumber": 334
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; rng = np.random.default_rng(0)",
            "lineNumber": 335
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; ch = rng.uniform(0, 100, (20, 1))",
            "lineNumber": 336
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; zh = rng.standard_normal(20)",
            "lineNumber": 337
          },
          {
            "text": "    &gt;&gt;&gt; mlemodelplot(ch, zh)",
            "lineNumber": 338
          },
          {
            "text": "    \"\"\"",
            "lineNumber": 339
          },
          {
            "text": "    zh = zh.reshape(zh.size, 1)",
            "lineNumber": 340,
            "isSignature": true
          },
          {
            "text": " ",
            "lineNumber": 341
          },
          {
            "text": "  cov=zh.dot(zh.T)",
            "lineNumber": 342
          },
          {
            "text": "  covu=cov[np.triu_indices(zh.size)]",
            "lineNumber": 343
          }
        ]
